about: The hand-offs a promo pack makes: one per workflow the offer has to reach. Each names its workflow (components/WORKFLOWS.md, The named workflows), the role that takes it, the calendar it reads its dates from, and its door: the command that starts the target component. A door whose `requires` file is missing in this checkout is a gap. `spends: false` doors run once the owner has approved the offer words. `drafts_only: true` doors spend usage but only write drafts (nothing sent, uploaded or published): they run when the owner's approval also says go on drafts. Every other spending door is written into the hand-off for the role's holder. A hand-off with no door is a gap, listed on every pack.

handoffs.makes: The brand's top video winners, each with the moment's offer ending
handoffs.ready_by: the day before the window opens: filed for the owner's approval page
handoffs.gap: ad-variations has no lever that sets an offer ending by itself; the ending is carried to its planner as the campaign plan

handoffs.makes: Static ads redone with the moment's offer
handoffs.ready_by: the day before the window opens: filed for the owner's approval page

door.then: the pack fills the sprint's offer, moment, until and never from the approved words

handoffs.makes: Every email the month's calendar places inside the window
handoffs.count: the calendar's email sends inside the window
handoffs.ready_by: one working day before each send

door.reads: the calendar's own hand-off (components/marketing-calendar/handoff.json) and email-production's calendar_handoff snapshot per send
door.then: only the sends email-production has not written yet; design, upload and scheduling stay with the Email campaign workflow

handoffs.makes: Every text the month's calendar places inside the window
handoffs.count: the calendar's sms sends inside the window
handoffs.ready_by: one working day before each send

door.then: writes the texts as drafts; a person approves and sends

handoffs.makes: The promo on the store: top bar, offer box, gift row, pop-up
handoffs.ready_by: on preview two days before the window opens; going live is the owner's call

door.reads: the live store, read only: what each store piece shows now and what the promo would set; apply is the owner's go in that workflow

handoffs.gap: storefront-promo-edit is not in this checkout; the store words and dates are filed here for the page builder

handoffs.makes: The offer inside each acquisition funnel: packages, codes, page lines
handoffs.ready_by: on a branch two days before the window opens; merging is the owner's call
handoffs.gap: no funnel component has a door; the funnel lines are filed here for the page builder, and the funnel's own banner and price lines are checked by hand against them

stock.reads: a stock runway read (one row per item: sku, name, available, backup, per_day, runs_out, reorder_by, status), given with --stock
stock.gap: stock-runway is not in the toolkit yet; its read is handed to the pack as a file
